description: This is a PHP unit test class for testing the MenuDao class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically focused on menu item enabling and retrieval functions in the human resource management system.

classes.name: MenuDaoTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing MenuDao methods related to menu item management in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures and the MenuDao object before each test.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItems
methods.description: Tests enabling of module menu items by IDs.

methods.name: testEnableModuleMenuItemsByTitle
methods.description: Tests enabling menu items by module name and specific titles.

methods.name: testGetMenuLevel
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of menu item details such as title, parent, level, order, and status.

methods.name: testGetModuleByName
methods.description: Tests retrieval of module information via module name.
